properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior...
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description:
Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat.
The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms.
This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee...

Attractive four bedroom apartment situated within close proximity to local transport links, offering convenient access to the city, and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and nearby recreational facilities. The property comprises; a spacious open-plan living and dining area, a modern fitted kitchen, and a private balcony providing ample natural light.The apartment also benefits from a utility cupboard and a guest cloakroom. There are four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en-suite shower room, along with a contemporary family bathroom.Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating, secure entry system, lift access, and a well-presented interior throughout..

Attractive three bedroom house situated within easy reach of local transport links, providing convenient access to surrounding areas, and within walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and nearby recreational amenities.The property comprises; two well-proportioned reception rooms, a modern fitted kitchen with dining space, and direct access to the rear garden, making it ideal for family living and entertaining. The house further benefits from a utility area and a ground floor cloakroom.To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with a matching suite.Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating, ample storage, and a well-presented interior throughout..

Four bedroom flat located close to local shops, schools and public transport. The property comprises a living room, a separate kitchen and a small dining area. There is also a basic bathroom and WC.To the first floor there are three bedrooms. The property has a small garden to the rear. Additional features include partial double glazing, basic heating facilities and a functional interior. The house would benefit from general updating and maintenance, making it suitable for buyers looking for a renovation project..

Well-presented four bedroom flat situated within convenient reach of local transport links, shops, schools and other local amenities. The property offers spacious and well-planned accommodation throughout.The flat comprises a bright and airy living/dining area and a modern fitted kitchen with ample storage and worktop space. There are four well-proportioned bedrooms, making the property ideal for families, sharers or home working.The accommodation is completed by a contemporary family bathroom, with the added benefit of a separate WC/ensuite (where applicable).Additional features include double glazing, central heating, good storage, and a well-maintained interior throughout..

Impressive eight bedroom house situated within easy reach of local transport links, shops, schools and other amenities. The property offers extensive and versatile accommodation, making it ideal for a large family, multi-generational living or investment purposes.The house comprises multiple reception rooms providing flexible living and dining space, along with a modern fitted kitchen offering ample storage and worktop space. The layout is well suited for both everyday family life and entertaining.All eight bedrooms are well proportioned, with the property further benefiting from several bathrooms, including family bathrooms and en-suite facilities.Additional features include double glazing, central heating, generous storage throughout and a well-maintained interior. Externally, the property offers private outdoor space, adding to its appeal....
